items.title: Bill Bourgeois Interview, 1959-12-10
items.q: Played with Louis quite a while here. Before Louis gave the band up to go to New York, then I took over the band.

ctx.x: Were they mostly New Orleans guys?

All New Orleans. All New Orleans colors. Al Belanco played trumpet and Earl Danton, saxophone, I played alto, lead alto and who was it? Tony Costa I believe played tenor. And Johnny Castang played drums. Frank Federico, and later we ended up with Louis Prima for quite a while. Federico and Castang, myself. Played with Louis quite a while here. Before Louis gave the band up to go to New York, then I took over the band.
